title: SCP-SatComPlate scenario 0.2
description: Authoritative closed-world input for one SatCompute online simulation or deterministic offline topology export.

schema_version.description: Scenario contract version; version 0.2 is required by this schema.

scenario_name.description: Stable filesystem-safe scenario name used in manifests and output labels.

simulation.description: Simulation clock bounds expressed in user-facing seconds.

constellation.description: Circular orbital shell and stable external satellite identity layout.

network.description: Candidate ISLs, distance gate, link resources, delay mode, and periodic update cadence.

routing.description: Deterministic IPv4 routing selection and route-recomputation behavior.

workloads.description: Referenced transfer, compute-resource, and task inputs plus compatibility behavior.

trace_export.description: Deterministic offline JSON slice cadence and end-point inclusion policy.

randomness.description: Explicit ns-3 seed, run, and assigned stream base used for reproducibility.

seconds.description: A finite non-negative duration in seconds with no precision finer than one nanosecond.

positive_seconds.description: A finite positive duration in seconds with no precision finer than one nanosecond.

optional_path.description: A non-empty path resolved relative to the scenario file, or null when the input is disabled.

start_time_s.description: Simulation start time in seconds; ns-3 execution currently starts at exactly 0 s.

duration_s.description: Positive simulated duration in seconds, converted exactly to integer nanoseconds.

orbit_provider.description: Position source: ns3-circular computes ECEF positions online; json-replay reuses audited slices.

constellation_name.description: Stable constellation token recorded in topology and run manifests.

constellation_pattern.description: Orbital-plane RAAN span: walker-star spans 180 degrees and walker-delta spans 360 degrees.

num_orbits.description: Number of orbital planes; stable satellite ID equals plane times satellites_per_orbit plus slot.

satellites_per_orbit.description: Number of stable satellite slots in every orbital plane.

altitude_m.description: Circular orbit altitude above the ns-3 reference Earth surface in metres.

inclination_deg.description: Orbital inclination in degrees in the half-open interval [0, 180).

phase_diff.description: When true, odd planes receive the legacy alternating half-slot phase offset; this is not Walker F.

orbit_epoch_offset_s.description: Non-negative physical orbit sampling offset from the scenario epoch in seconds.

network.description: Satellite-only network state and update policy.

topology_source.description: online evaluates the shared orbit core periodically; json-replay reads deterministic topology slices.

replay_directory.description: Scenario-relative directory containing replay slices, or null for online topology.

isl_candidate_strategy.description: Fixed candidate-neighbour graph; plus-grid never substitutes a nearer non-candidate satellite.

seam_enabled.description: Whether inter-plane candidates connect the final plane back to the first plane.

max_isl_distance_m.description: Maximum active candidate-link distance in metres, with equality considered active.

delay_mode.description: fixed uses one configured propagation delay; distance derives one-way delay from current separation.

fixed_delay_us.description: Positive one-way propagation delay in microseconds for fixed mode; null for distance mode.

network_update_interval_s.description: Positive periodic orbit, distance-gate, link-delay, and topology evaluation interval in seconds.

link_bandwidth_bps.description: Full-duplex data rate of each active ISL in bits per second.

isl_mtu_bytes.description: Point-to-point ISL maximum transmission unit in bytes.

isl_queue_bytes.description: Drop-tail queue capacity per ISL net device in bytes.

receiver_rcv_buf_bytes.description: UDP receive socket buffer capacity per receiver in bytes.

mode.description: One of the five migrated deterministic IPv4 routing modes.

hash_seed.description: Unsigned 64-bit seed for legacy FNV and HRW candidate selection.

recompute_policy.description: Route tables rebuild only when the effective active-edge set changes.

workloads.description: Independent versioned input references and transfer/task compatibility controls.

transfer_trace.description: Scenario-relative TransferTrace JSON path, or null when direct transfers are disabled.

compute_profile.description: Scenario-relative static satellite ComputeProfile JSON path, or null when task compute is disabled.

task_trace.description: Scenario-relative TaskTrace JSON path, or null when task compute is disabled.

transfer_chunk_mode.description: fixed uses transfer_payload_bytes; size-aware uses the preserved three-tier payload policy.

transfer_payload_bytes.description: UDP application payload ceiling in bytes for fixed chunking mode.

task_completion_policy.description: strict returns failure for unfinished tasks; report records partial completion as a valid run.

trace_export.description: Offline trace output controls independent of the online network update interval.

enabled.description: Whether to emit deterministic position and topology JSON slices.

interval_s.description: Positive interval in seconds between exported offline topology slices.

include_final_state.description: Whether to add a final slice at the simulation end when it is not already on the cadence.

format.description: Version 0.2 emits canonical per-time JSON slice files.

seed.description: ns-3 RngSeedManager seed in the unsigned 32-bit range; fixed inputs reproduce fixed streams.

run.description: ns-3 independent run number in the unsigned 64-bit range.

stream_start.description: First non-negative deterministic stream index reserved for SatCompute objects.
